name: repovibe
description: Local-first Chrome MV3 GitHub theme customization extension

scripts.check: node --check shared/core.js && node --check content.js && node --check popup.js && node --check studio.js && node --check scripts/verify-package.js && node --check tests/live/live-helpers.js && node --check tests/live/github.live.js
scripts.package: rm -f RepoVibe-Extension.zip && zip -r -X RepoVibe-Extension.zip manifest.json shared content.js popup.html popup.js studio.html studio.js ui.css icons README.md
